question: Under what condition is the nondual conduct of the caruka said to be undertaken together with eating?
premises: The nondual conduct of the caruka is posited as a known form.
Those born of mantra are associated with that conduct.
Eating is said to occur together with that association.
inference: The nondual caruka conduct is performed in conjunction with eating by those born of mantra.
uncertainties: Token '?' is irrecoverable from the supplied list and blocks full syntactic linking.
plain_english: The nondual conduct of the caruka is undertaken with those born of mantra, together with eating.
